Ashurbanipal.fact: Urtak was successfully driven back into Elam, dying shortly thereafter. He was succeeded as Elamite king by Teumman, who was unrelated to the previous monarch and had to stabilize his rule by killing his political rivals.

Ashurbanipal.fact: He was succeeded as Elamite king by Teumman, who was unrelated to the previous monarch and had to stabilize his rule by killing his political rivals. Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.fact: It is unknown if any Assyrian aid arrived, but Lydia was successfully freed from the Cimmerians.

Ashurbanipal.fact: They would not be driven out of Lydia completely until the reign of Ardys's grandson Alyattes.

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.fact: Meluhha might have referred to Egypt, though the Egyptians are not documented for certain to have aided Shamash-shum-ukin in the war.

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture
Ashurbanipal.question: Having endured both starvation and disease, _____ fell in 648, after a siege lasting two years
Ashurbanipal.fact: By 650 the situation looked grim, with Ashurbanipal's forces having besieged Sippar, Borsippa, Kutha and Babylon itself. During Ashurbanipal's siege of Babylon, the city entered into a period of famine.

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture
Ashurbanipal.question: At the time of the city's fall, a great fire also spread within _____
Ashurbanipal.fact: Having endured both starvation and disease, Babylon fell in 648, after a siege lasting two years. At the time of the city's fall, a great fire also spread within Babylon.

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.fact: Due to the defeat and death of a member of the Assyrian royal family, the defeat of Shamash-shum-ukin was Ashurbanipal's most problematic victory. The civil war also had significant broader consequences impacting Assyrian dominion.

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.fact: He was briefly replaced as king by Tammaritu II, who regained his throne.

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.fact: The Assyrians returned to Elam in 646 and Humban-haltash again abandoned Madaktu, fleeing first to the city Dur-Untash and then into the mountains in eastern Elam.

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture
Ashurbanipal.question: Susa, the great holy city, abode of their gods, seat of their mysteries, I conquered according to the word of Ashur and _____

Ashurbanipal.subject: Indian Architecture
Ashurbanipal.question: I destroyed the ziggurat of _____ [...]; I smashed its shining copper horns
